description: This file declares the H2BGraphicBufferProducer class, a converter wrapper for IGraphicBufferProducer, including method signatures for buffer management and connection handling in the graphics buffer queue system.

classes.name: H2BGraphicBufferProducer
classes.description: A converter class that wraps around HGraphicBufferProducer and BnGraphicBufferProducer to facilitate buffer operations in the graphics buffer queue system.

methods.name: requestBuffer
methods.description: Requests a graphic buffer for a given slot.

methods.name: setMaxDequeuedBufferCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of buffers that can be dequeued.

methods.name: dequeueBuffer
methods.description: Dequeues a buffer with specified parameters.

methods.name: detachBuffer
methods.description: Detaches a buffer from a slot.

methods.name: attachBuffer
methods.description: Attaches a buffer to a slot.

methods.name: setGenerationNumber
methods.description: Sets the generation number for buffers.

methods.name: setSharedBufferMode
methods.description: Enables or disables shared buffer mode.

methods.name: setDequeueTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for dequeuing buffers.

methods.name: getLastQueuedBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the last queued buffer and associated fence.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Gets a unique identifier for the buffer producer.
